Name: accordion
Title: Accordion
Summary: Native disclosure with an accessible summary.

Props.Name: name
Props.Description: Nonempty name groups details exclusively within the same tree.

Props.Name: open
Props.Description: Whether the disclosure is initially open.

Slots.Name: summary
Slots.Description: Accessible disclosure label; avoid nested interactive controls.

Requirements: The summary is the first child. Its native activation opens or closes the details.
Read root.open on toggle to synchronize adapter state; slot scope is an initial snapshot in the native factory.
For exclusive groups use the same nonempty name in the same tree, not necessarily siblings. Do not nest members of the same named group.
The owned content wrapper is the styling and motion target; adapters preserve native details semantics.

Name: alert-dialog
Title: Alert Dialog

Slots.Description: Local action primitives. Use native command=close and commandFor=id for a dismissing action.

Requirements: IDs must be unique within the document. Opening uses command="show-modal"; setting open alone is nonmodal.
On browsers without invoker commands, the adapter must call dialog.showModal() and dialog.close() from button handlers. Feature-detect command support.

Supply connected title and description IDs. For alert dialogs, the description slot is required; choose a least-destructive initial focus action with autofocus. Native cancel/close events and application action outcomes remain caller-owned.

Props.Description: Unique listbox popup ID, distinct from the trigger ID.

Props.Description: Placeholder text for the adapter-managed visible value.

Props.Description: Accessible trigger name when no label content is supplied.

Props.Name: ariaLabelledby
Props.Description: IDs of elements naming the visible trigger.

Props.Name: ariaDescribedby
Props.Description: IDs of help or error text describing the visible trigger.

Slots.Name: label
Slots.Description: Optional noninteractive phrasing label associated with the visible trigger. When omitted, provide an external label or accessible trigger name.

Slots.Name: options
Slots.Description: Required native option/optgroup content inserted into the select proxy. The adapter projects these options into the listbox.

Requirements: The factory supplies anatomy and initial native properties only. Adapter required: project native option/optgroup content into owned listbox options, synchronize selection, visible value/placeholder, disabled options, and aria-selected.

The owned hidden option node is a reusable styling prototype, not an active choice. The adapter clones it for projected options, removes hidden, and supplies option IDs, noninteractive native option text, selection, disabled, and highlight states.

The trigger id and popupId must be unique and distinct. The optional owned label and external Field labels target the visible trigger; provide an accessible name on both the trigger and adapter-managed listbox.

Adapter required: arrow/Home/End navigation, active descendant, typeahead, activation, Escape, return focus, and aria-expanded synchronization. Native popover visibility and light dismissal do not implement combobox keyboard behavior.

The native select proxy preserves name, disabled, required, options, submission, validation, and native reset semantics. Keep it mounted and CSS-clipped; do not use hidden or display:none. The adapter redirects invalid focus to the trigger and synchronizes reset with the native option selection baseline.
Adapter required: popup positioning relative to the trigger, viewport collision handling, and an appropriate visibility/focus fallback where popover is unsupported.

Omitting value preserves initial native selected options. Supplying value initializes the current native selection after options are inserted; the adapter decides whether a controlled initial selection establishes a reset baseline.
The native factory takes one HTMLElement per slot; framework converters may emit multiple native option/optgroup nodes.

Events.Description: Native selection notification; adapters synchronize visible state and application models.

Events.Description: Native popup visibility notification; adapters synchronize trigger aria-expanded and focus.

Styling: Style the owned root, label, trigger, value, chevron, and popup parts in the consuming design system. The native proxy control is an owned CSS target for visually clipping it while retaining form semantics.
The chevron is decorative. Derive visible trigger interaction states from the trigger; native validation and required states remain on the proxy control.
The adapter positions the popup; anchor positioning may be an enhancement. The factory emits no CSS, option projection, or keyboard listeners.

Props.Description: Disables both the native form proxy and visible input.

Props.Description: Text displayed when no options match the search.

Slots.Name: label
Slots.Description: Optional noninteractive phrasing label associated with the visible trigger. When omitted, provide an external label or accessible trigger name.

Slots.Name: options
Slots.Description: Required native option/optgroup content inserted into the select proxy. The adapter projects these options into the listbox.

Requirements: Adapter required: project native option/optgroup content using the hidden owned option prototype; synchronize selection, enabled choices, list naming and active-descendant focus.

The editable input query is separate from the native select value. Filter visible option text and optional data-keywords, preserve text editing/IME, skip disabled/hidden options, and implement arrows/Enter, Escape cancellation and Tab exit without implicit commitment.
The input id and popupId must be unique and distinct. Supply an owned/external label or accessible name; projected groups carry native optgroup labels.

Combobox requires native popover visibility, trigger-relative collision positioning, native form value/reset/required and fieldset-disabled propagation. Command remains inline and dispatches a selection notification on every activation, including the same action twice.

Keep the native select CSS-clipped, mounted and excluded from the accessibility tree and tab order. Release all observers/listeners on scope disposal. The factory supplies only anatomy; framework adapters supply interactions.

Events.Description: Native popup visibility notification; adapters synchronize trigger aria-expanded and focus.

Styling: Style every owned part, including the repeated option prototype and empty status. The decorative icon carries no semantics. Preserve the native value proxy while visually clipping it.
